privacy: Only abstract design observations are stored. Original attachments, paths, logos and recognizable layouts are excluded from the open-source package.
mother_rules: one dominant hero or information claim per frame
extreme scale contrast creates hierarchy before decoration
one dominant colour field plus one or two controlled accents
subjects participate in depth through overlap, shadow, crop or foreground occlusion
microtype, grain, scanlines and marks finish the frame but never compete with the hero
motion preserves the still-frame hierarchy and must reveal, compare, explain or pay off
long-form and short-form share design DNA but must reflow rather than crop
a grid is an optional information surface and never a default opener
